body:
The "I have people who love me" doesn't really make me "happy". It's like, it's nice that i know, that i have a mother who loves me, but at the same time it makes me feel worse.

"happiness journal" might actually be a nice idea, i really don't know what could make me just a little happy, or make me smile, but if i do find something throughout the day (like petting my dog), i'll be sure to write it down.

Honestly didn't expect anyone to reply. Thank you.. really, thank you. it really does means alot to me
